$comment: Static trace library for the NemoTrace viewer. No server: the viewer reads this document and resolves each entry's artifact itself. An entry may only be listed with an artifact that is publication-profile, vault-free, and attested; `gist` stays null until a maintainer publishes it with their own credential (plan.md §5.4, §9.1).

entries.title: CVXPYgen H50 autoresearch — reviewed fake-model publication fixture
entries.description: A real compiled autoresearch.nemo workflow run against the fake model and fake harness, transformed by the publication transform. Shows a three-trial constrained search (preflight failure, no-improvement rejection, accepted improvement), policy checks, and tool calls.

attestation.consent: Fake-model campaign fixture reviewed field by field: no credentials, no absolute paths, no raw reasoning, no candidate source. Safe to publish.

entries.notes: Fake model and fake harness: this fixture exercises the trace format and viewer, not benchmark performance. The candidate digests and mechanism IDs stay opaque even here (redaction-policy §11); the archive carries no vault.
